name: Campus IA mega AI data center (Fouju)
developer: Societe Campus IA (SPV; president Thibaud Desfosses)
notes: Huge AI datacenter campus near Melun, announced at Choose France 2025 (est. ~50bn EUR). 11 buildings over 24-90 ha, ~86,000 m2 authorized surface. Public enquiry commission gave a favorable report for the building permit on 2026-07-02; ICPE/IOTA authorizations sought with the prefect. First phase delivery targeted 2028 (2033 per developer interview). Strong local/activist opposition.

name: EDF conversion of former Montereau-Fault-Yonne thermal plant to data center
notes: EDF studying conversion of the decommissioned Montereau-Fault-Yonne thermal power plant (Seine-et-Marne) into a large data center; very early stage, no construction date or cost estimate published yet.

name: Webaxys data center Saint-Romain-de-Colbosc (Eco Normandie park, near Le Havre)
notes: Green/ecoresponsible data center in the Eco Normandie business park at Saint-Romain-de-Colbosc (Seine-Maritime); construction reported 2022 through end-2023; operator Webaxys presents it as a green DC and network operator; later ATEE site visit implies operational.

name: Orange Normandy data center (Le Havre/Rouen area)
notes: Orange announced one of three new French data centers in Normandy (CCI article references Le Havre and Rouen), part of a consolidation replacing 10 legacy energy-intensive sites; exact commune not yet specified - likely Seine-Maritime.

name: Digital Realty Paris Digital Park (La Courneuve)
notes: Largest data center in France at La Courneuve; ~40,000 m2 of server rooms; press reports 130 MW supply and 2bn EUR investment; opened/ramping since summer 2024 (Interxion = Digital Realty EMEA brand); capacity is press-reported (B), existence solid.

name: Digital Realty second La Courneuve campus project
notes: Digital Realty investing ~2bn EUR more in an even more massive project adjacent to Paris Digital Park at La Courneuve; announced status as of Oct 2024; permits/filings to verify.

name: Data Hills data center project (Aulnay-sous-Bois)
notes: SNC Data Hills project on boulevard Andre Citroen at Aulnay-sous-Bois, bordering Parc du Sausset; environmental-authority/activist (FNE) opposition; department prefecture hosted the public enquiry per FR methodology (Seine-Saint-Denis data center enquiries).

name: Data center project Le Bourget
notes: Another data center project at Le Bourget opposed by residents and ecologist groups; developer not named in coverage; DataCenterMap Paris listing also references a SEGRO Le Bourget site (C-grade lead for same area).

name: Equinix Saint-Denis campus (PA3, PA10, PA5 Aubervilliers)
notes: Equinix PA3 (114 rue Ambroise Croizat, Saint-Denis), PA10 and PA5 (Aubervilliers) operational carrier-neutral colocation; Seine-Saint-Denis hosts ~23 operating DCs - Europe's densest data-storage concentration (0.8 TWh consumption 2024).

name: ETIX Paris #2 (Saint-Denis)
notes: Directory-listed ETIX Paris #2 facility near the La Courneuve A86 exit; 2N+1 UPS power and N+1 cooling per Baxtel; C-grade until operator-confirmed.

name: Albi colocation data center (directory/market-listed)
notes: Albi listed among existing/upcoming colocation data center locations in a France market portfolio database; no operator-level verification found in web searches; likely a small regional colo. C-grade lead only.

name: Belfort colocation data center (directory/market-listed)
notes: Belfort listed among existing/upcoming colocation data center locations in a France market portfolio database; no operator-level verification found; likely small colo. C-grade lead only.

name: Scaleway data center campus (Saint-Ouen-l'Aumone)
notes: Scaleway operates a campus at Saint-Ouen-l'Aumone (Val-d'Oise) per market/aggregator source; FR methodology pivots Scaleway DC2-DC5 permits to Vitry-sur-Seine and Saint-Ouen-l'Aumone (DC5 reported >20 MW IT elsewhere); capacity unverified here. C-grade lead.

name: Icade data center Rungis (Parc d'affaires Paris Orly-Rungis)
notes: ~85 MW IT data center (CCIngenierie project sheet, incl. HV substations), ~31,400 m2 plot / 15,940 m2 built, 70 rue des Solets; public consultation April 2025; waste-heat recovery planned for the Rungis MIN heat network; one of four large Val-de-Marne DC projects.

name: SEGRO data center Bonneuil-sur-Marne (Sucy-Bonneuil)
notes: SEGRO datacenter at Bonneuil-sur-Marne: enquiry report dated 2025-09-18; Val-de-Marne prefect subsequently delivered the environmental authorization (autorisation environnementale). Prefecture page = A-grade.

name: Double data center project Villeneuve-Saint-Georges (Philips Signify brownfield)
notes: Local coverage names this double data center on the former Philips Signify site at Villeneuve-Saint-Georges as the most advanced of the four big Val-de-Marne DC projects; developer not named in the snippets.

name: Data center project Vitry-sur-Seine
notes: Local press lists Vitry-sur-Seine among municipalities set to host new data centers in Val-de-Marne; Scaleway DC2/DC3 campuses are also sited at Vitry per market sources; project-level details pending.

name: Poitiers colocation data centers (2 facilities, directory-listed)
notes: DataCenterMap lists 2 colocation/cloud facilities in Poitiers (Vienne); operator-level verification not completed (directory page rate-limited); likely small regional colos. C-grade lead.

name: Telehouse TH3 campus Magny-les-Hameaux (Magny 1)
notes: TH3 campus in Yvelines since 2009; gridreadiness lists ~25 MW Tier III with RTE connection; ICPE/environmental extension dossier (building P34) shows ongoing campus expansion; capacity B-grade.

name: Telehouse Magny 2 (TH3 campus extension)
notes: Second TH3 building: construction started Nov 2022, 12,000 m2 IT surface; first tranche inaugurated Oct 2023 as the largest datacenter of the Yvelines (minister Barrot present); eco-responsible design.

name: Velizy-Villacoublay mixed program + data center project
notes: Official project-dossier text (MRAe/DDT-style context) describes construction of a mixed program and a data center at Velizy-Villacoublay (9 km SW of Paris, Yvelines); details unverified - lead only (C).

name: Aubergenville colocation data center (directory/market-listed)
notes: Aubergenville listed among existing/upcoming colocation data center locations in a France market portfolio database; no operator-level verification found. C-grade lead only.
